description: Provider JSON schema illustration; no live prices or fabricated values included.

quotes.observed: ISO 8601 with time zone, e.g. yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss+07:00
quotes.verified: BOOLEAN true ONLY when source and terms are verifiable
